about: Frames that changed between 0.5.x and 0.7. 'frame' is what 0.7 lays out, 'was' what 0.5.1 did. 'at' is an element id, then child indices. scripts/check-migration.py checks them.

checks.why: a block's children don't shrink: height: 100px overflows the 50px block
and the next child follows it
height: 50% of an auto-height column acts as auto (empty: 0)
so the fixed child keeps its 20px
height: 50% in a flex-start (unstretched) item acts as auto: its content's 40px
control: a stretched item's height is definite, so 50% of 80 resolves
margin-inline-start is the right margin under direction: rtl
padding-inline-end is the left padding under rtl
CSSWG #3648: the empty max-content track stays at 0 instead of taking the spanning item's leftover
so column 2 starts right after the 19px gap
CSSWG #3648, min-content variant: the empty track stays at 0
